section_summary: This section records Japanese merchant ship movements, cargoes, passengers, fuel supplies, and reported changes in shipping routes during July–September 1941. It also documents Japanese Embassy inquiries about vessels delayed at the Panama Canal, concern over recalled shipping, and a civilian warning about Japanese fishing vessels off the Pacific coast.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Puntarenas
subfiles.from: U.S. Legation, San José; Dudley W. Dwyre
subfiles.about: Reports the Heiyo Maru's arrival, transshipment of Balboa cargo and passengers, and a visit by two Japanese passengers.
subfiles.summary: The vessel avoided the Canal Zone. Sobei Hara and Hitomi Tada visited San José and met Jyoho Kawakuba.

subfiles.title: Cargo discharged from Heiyo Maru
subfiles.from: Alex A. Cohen, Military Attaché's office
subfiles.about: Lists cargo unloaded at Puntarenas for transshipment.
subfiles.summary: Includes cement, machinery, shoes, motors, earthenware, rugs, and other goods.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru passenger list
subfiles.about: Lists the passengers aboard the Heiyo Maru at Puntarenas.
subfiles.summary: Three pages record first, tourist, and third class passengers, with origins, nationalities, ages, and destinations.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru movement
subfiles.about: Reports the Kiyokawa Maru's arrival from Taltal and departure for Huanillo.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 8 and sailed August 9.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Kiyokawa Maru movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Antofagasta telegram for Navy.

subfiles.title: Philippine oil company reports
subfiles.from: Claude A. Buss, U.S. High Commissioner's Office
subfiles.about: Forwards reports of oil sales to Japanese and French vessels in July.
subfiles.summary: Encloses four oil company letters in duplicate.

subfiles.title: Philippine oil company reports, duplicate
subfiles.about: Duplicates the cover letter forwarding July oil sales reports.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate of the preceding transmittal.

subfiles.title: Asiatic Petroleum supply report
subfiles.about: Reports no July deliveries to French or Japanese vessels and inquiries about supplies.
subfiles.summary: Japanese whaling vessels sought fuel and lubricants; the company also declined a request for the Si Kiang.

subfiles.title: Caltex petroleum sales report
subfiles.about: Lists July bunker fuel and lubricant deliveries to vessels.
subfiles.summary: Records sales to four ships and the Panamanian tanker Bahrein.

subfiles.title: Standard-Vacuum bunker deliveries
subfiles.about: Lists July bunker deliveries to French and Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Includes four French vessels and Banshu Maru No. 11.

subfiles.title: Tide Water sales to Japanese fishermen
subfiles.about: Reports July diesel sales to Japanese fishing launches.
subfiles.summary: One remaining customer with three launches bought 22.3 tons.

subfiles.title: Asiatic Petroleum supply report, duplicate
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Asiatic Petroleum report.
subfiles.summary: No July French or Japanese deliveries; several inquiries were declined.

subfiles.title: Caltex petroleum sales report, duplicate
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Caltex sales report.
subfiles.summary: Lists bunker fuel and lubricant deliveries.

subfiles.title: Standard-Vacuum bunker deliveries, duplicate
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Standard-Vacuum delivery report.
subfiles.summary: Lists July French and Japanese vessel bunkering.

subfiles.title: Tide Water sales to Japanese fishermen, duplicate
subfiles.about: Duplicates the report of diesel sales to fishing launches.
subfiles.summary: Reports 22.3 tons sold in July.

subfiles.title: Havana Maru cotton shipment
subfiles.about: Reports Havana Maru sailing for Taihoku with raw cotton.
subfiles.summary: Sailed August 9 carrying 20,774 bales.

subfiles.title: Havana Maru cotton shipment paraphrase
subfiles.about: Restates the Havana Maru cotton shipment report.
subfiles.summary: Records its August 9 departure with 20,774 bales.

subfiles.title: Asuka Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports the Asuka Maru's route and onward cotton loading plans.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Buenos Aires via Magellan and departed toward Pisco, other Peruvian ports, and Japan.

subfiles.title: Asuka Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Asuka Maru movement report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases its arrival and onward route.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Akagi Maru arriving at Callao and sailing for Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 8 from Yokohama and sailed August 9 via Mollendo.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards the Akagi Maru movement report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Callao arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Heiyo Maru's route and nitrate cargo.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 26 and sailed August 29 toward Iquique, Peru, Manzanillo, and Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Heiyo Maru nitrate cargo and route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Antofagasta telegram.

subfiles.title: Yadogawa departure
subfiles.about: Reports Yadogawa sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Sailed August 12.

subfiles.title: Sakito Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Sakito Maru's route and ore cargo.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 30 from Coquimbo, then sailed with lead and copper ores.

subfiles.title: Sakito Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Sakito Maru's route and ore cargo.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Antofagasta telegram.

subfiles.title: Yamaura Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Yamaura Maru sailing for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Departed August 13, reportedly via the Strait of Magellan.

subfiles.title: Yamaura Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Yamaura Maru's departure and rumored route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Santos report.

subfiles.title: Japanese vessel sailings canceled
subfiles.about: Reports canceled or commandeered Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Morie Maru and Kokkai Maru sailings were canceled; Ganges Maru's schedule was unchanged.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Yamazato Maru sailing for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Departed August 13; Cape Horn was a rumored route.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Yamazato Maru's movements and rumored Cape Horn route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Santos telegram.

subfiles.title: Suspension of Japanese exports to Panama
subfiles.about: Reports a newspaper claim that shipping shortages stopped Japanese exports to Panama.
subfiles.summary: A Japanese exporters' cable reportedly told merchants to stop sales and notify Curaçao and Colón.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Buenos Aires Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 12 from Valparaíso and sailed August 15 for Kobe via Magellan.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Buenos Aires Maru's movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Santos report.

subfiles.title: Takagi inquiry about Panama Canal transit
subfiles.about: Records Takagi's report that a Norwegian ship transited the supposedly restricted canal.
subfiles.summary: Takagi cited the Reinhold's July 15 transit.

subfiles.title: Proposed reply to Japanese Embassy
subfiles.about: Suggests explaining that canal repairs prevented regular merchant transit.
subfiles.summary: Proposes a brief reply based on the Canal authorities' announcement.

subfiles.title: Further inquiry on Yamazaki and Tokai Maru
subfiles.about: Recommends further inquiry after the Embassy disputed the explanation for detained Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Takagi said other foreign vessels were transiting freely and asked about both the Yamazaki Maru and Tokai Maru.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Takagi on Yamazaki Maru
subfiles.about: Records Takagi's request for the prompt release of Yamazaki Maru and subsequent inquiry about Tokai Maru.
subfiles.summary: Takagi said commercial cargo and other passing ships made the delay hard to understand. Schuler promised to expedite official inquiries; Takagi later reported the Tokai Maru was also detained.

subfiles.title: Suggested explanation of canal delays
subfiles.about: Suggests telling the Embassy that canal repairs may explain the delay.
subfiles.summary: The War Department had no specific detention information.

subfiles.title: War Department information on canal repairs
subfiles.about: Relays Colonel Moore's lack of detention information and knowledge of canal repairs.
subfiles.summary: Repairs might be holding up vessels.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Iguchi on Yamazaki Maru
subfiles.about: Records Iguchi's request for help obtaining Yamazaki Maru's release.
subfiles.summary: Iguchi also thanked the Department for its Norfolk Maru inquiry.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Heiyo Maru's Callao call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 13 from Kobe and sailed August 15 via Mollendo.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Callao, copy
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Heiyo Maru Callao report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the August 13 arrival and August 15 sailing.

subfiles.title: Yama Zubi Maru inquiry and Kurama Maru cargo
subfiles.about: Reports no local call by Yama Zubi Maru and Kurama Maru's discharge at Rio Grande.
subfiles.summary: Kurama Maru unloaded glass and metal sheets for Porto Alegre and loaded no cargo.

subfiles.title: Yama Zubi Maru inquiry and Kurama Maru cargo, copy
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Porto Alegre vessel report.
subfiles.summary: No Yama Zubi Maru call; Kurama Maru discharged cargo.

subfiles.title: Yama Zubi Maru inquiry and Kurama Maru cargo, second copy
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Porto Alegre vessel report again.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Rio Grande cargo details.

subfiles.title: Yamazato and Yamaura Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports both ships departing for Buenos Aires and likely returning to the Pacific.
subfiles.summary: Both arrived August 16 and sailed August 17.

subfiles.title: Montevideo vessel report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamazato and Yamaura Maru report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases their Montevideo calls and expected Pacific route.

subfiles.title: Japanese ships unloading on U.S. West Coast
subfiles.about: Reports cargo unloading by two Japanese ships and a tanker arriving for petroleum.
subfiles.summary: Tatuta Maru unloaded at San Francisco, Heian Maru at Seattle, and Daieanguru Maru arrived at Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kunikawa Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports Kunikawa Maru's arrival from Arica and sailing via Manta.
subfiles.summary: Arrived August 14 and departed August 18.

subfiles.title: Kunikawa Maru report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Kunikawa Maru movement report.
subfiles.summary: Contains an erroneous reading of Arica as Africa.

subfiles.title: Corrected Kunikawa Maru report
subfiles.about: Corrects the port of origin in the earlier Navy paraphrase.
subfiles.summary: Specifies Arica, not Africa.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for fuel at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Relays a naval attaché report of fuel sought for four Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese Minister requested diesel for three unnamed ships and bunker oil for Rakuyo Maru.

subfiles.title: Japanese ships in Netherlands Indies waters
subfiles.about: Reports locations of five Japanese ships in Indies waters.
subfiles.summary: Lists vessels at Banyuwangi, Tarakan, Palembang, Manado, and en route to Ambon.

subfiles.title: Indies vessel locations for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Japanese vessel location report.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Batavia telegram.

subfiles.title: Corrected Indies vessel locations
subfiles.about: Corrects vessel names and locations in the Batavia report.
subfiles.summary: Identifies Dai Ichitora Maru en route from Makassar to Ambon.

subfiles.title: Dai Ichitora Maru name correction
subfiles.about: Corrects the ship name in the Navy paraphrase.
subfiles.summary: Specifies Dai Ichitora Maru.

subfiles.title: Akagi and Asuka Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of Akagi and Asuka Maru.
subfiles.summary: Both sailed September 4 for Kobe via Chancay.

subfiles.title: Callao vessel report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Akagi and Asuka Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Lima telegram.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports Akagi Maru's arrival from Arica and departure toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Departed August 20 via Manzanillo, Mexico.

subfiles.title: Kunikawa Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports Kunikawa Maru's Callao call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived September 4 and sailed September 5 via Chancay.

subfiles.title: Japanese shipping policy and Bland Bill
subfiles.about: Shares press-based analysis of Japan's reduction of merchant shipping to the United States.
subfiles.summary: Walden links the reduction to scarce return cargoes, trade restrictions, and the proposed Bland Ship Warrant Bill. He says Japanese lines had no Atlantic or Gulf sailings scheduled beyond mid-July.

subfiles.title: Japanese shipping policy and Bland Bill, duplicate
subfiles.about: Duplicates Walden's analysis of reduced Japanese sailings.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the discussion of the Bland bill and Japanese routes.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Walden letter
subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of Walden's July 9 shipping letter.
subfiles.summary: Thanks Walden on Hornbeck's behalf.

subfiles.title: Routing sheet for restricted information
subfiles.about: Records departmental routing of restricted material.
subfiles.summary: Mostly stamps and routing marks.

subfiles.title: Peruvian fuel and border situation
subfiles.about: Reports Peru's intended fuel supply to Rakuyo Maru and developments near Puerto Bolívar.
subfiles.summary: The message says Rakuyo Maru was to receive 500 tons of fuel and discusses Peru's oil policy. It also reports Peruvian advances, captured arms, and a halt in fighting.

subfiles.title: Rumor of Japanese ship recall
subfiles.about: Records a press inquiry about reports that Japanese ships had been ordered home.
subfiles.summary: Langdon said U.S. offices in Japan had not yet reported such a recall.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Callao in September
subfiles.about: Reports Heiyo Maru's September Callao call.
subfiles.summary: Arrived September 4 from Valparaíso and sailed September 6 for Kobe.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru September report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Heiyo Maru's September movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Lima telegram.

subfiles.title: White House acknowledgment routing sheet
subfiles.about: Records routing of an acknowledgment concerning the following correspondence.
subfiles.summary: Contains stamps and routing marks.

subfiles.title: Gearhart forwards Miscovich letter
subfiles.about: Forwards John Miscovich's warning about Japanese fishing vessels.
subfiles.summary: Gearhart vouches for Miscovich and asks that the information reach the appropriate agency.

subfiles.title: Mischovich warning on Japanese fishing vessels
subfiles.about: Urges a Pacific coastal patrol and reports claims about Japanese fishing vessels near Mexico and Alaska.
subfiles.summary: Mischovich suggests using the U.S. fishing fleet for patrol or mine laying. He lists Japanese vessels said to be in U.S. waters or bound for Alaska, and relays unverified claims about Japanese personnel and activity near canneries.
